pages.text: The Pale Saber is the standard melee weapon of the artillerymen, grenadiers, artillery captains, and company captains. 7.0 attack damage, 2.5 attack speed, 962 durability.
Artillerymen and grenadiers do not carry it at rest — only when a foe closes in and they are forced to fight do they put away torch or bomb and draw the Pale Saber in self-defense.
